program:
app "Events" calendar ink
table event name text, day date
each event where day >= today sort day
  stack card gap 1
    draw 100, 6
      rect 0, 0, 100, 6 fill soft radius 3
      rect 0, 0, 100 * clamp(1 - (it.day - today) / 30, 0.05, 1), 6 fill if(it.day - today <= 3, bad, if(it.day - today <= 10, warn, good)) radius 3
    row
      it.name bold grow
      it.day - today "days left"
form event, "Add event"
describe:
Events, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- event: name: text; day: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each event where day is at least today sorted by day:
  - a drawing made of rectangles.
  - text: its name.
  - text: its day minus today, "days left".
- a form to add a event.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:

    row gap 1

      button "-50" tap add entry kid = k, amount = 50, kind = Spent

form entry, "Add other amount"

program:
app "Kabaddi" trophy slate
table point team pick Team_1|Team_2, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Team_1)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Team_2)
setting winat num = 40 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Team 1" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Team_1, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Team_1, pts = 10
  stack card grow align center
    "Team 2" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Team_2, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+10" tap add point team = Team_2, pts = 10
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Team 1 win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Team 2 win!" head color good
list point
describe:
Kabaddi, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Team 1, Team 2; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 40.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Team 1.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Team 2.
Shows:
- text: "Team 1".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Team 1, pts set to 1.
- a button "+10"; a tap adds a point with team set to Team 1, pts set to 10.
- text: "Team 2".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Team 2, pts set to 1.
- a button "+10"; a tap adds a point with team set to Team 2, pts set to 10.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Team 1 win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Team 2 win!".
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
